name: Morpho Lodging: Bed and Breakfasts
description: Independent bed and breakfasts in the US (not Maine) with roughly 3 to 15 rooms. Almost always an owner-operator, often a couple, frequently living on site, many of whom bought the B&B as a lifestyle change; a smaller group are portfolio owners holding several B&Bs or small inns in a destination town. The owner makes the decisions and is reachable. Operating, or opening within six months. Retainer fit is roughly 8 or more rooms, strong rates, or a portfolio; 3 to 7 rooms are cohort or QuickScan prospects and are kept, just segmented. Does NOT qualify: inns over 15 rooms (inn ICP), hotels, hostels, single Airbnb rooms in a private home with no business, B&B directories and associations, B&Bs run by a management company, retirement or care homes, restaurants that only serve breakfast, and properties listed for sale as closed. Room count must be verified from the website (a stated number or a rooms listing).
offer_context: Morpho sells, in order of fit for this avatar, the Operator Control Room cohort (learn to run the operation with AI and keep control), the AI visibility QuickScan (direct bookings and whether AI search recommends them), and a fractional operations retainer at the top end (8+ rooms, strong rates, or a portfolio). Buying signals: owners personally replying to every review, limited or no online booking, OTA-heavy presence, a website not updated in years, losing a key part-time helper, a drop in bookings, burnout language ('we have not had a vacation in years'), deciding whether to sell.

segments.label: 3 to 7 rooms: cohort or QuickScan prospect

options.owner_operator: the innkeepers are the whole operation: breakfast, housekeeping, reservations, marketing; often a couple living on site
options.portfolio_owner_manager: owns several B&Bs or small inns, usually in one destination town, with innkeepers or managers at each
options.recent_acquirer: bought the B&B in the last 24 months ('new innkeepers', 'under new ownership', 'we purchased in 2025'), often a lifestyle change or first hospitality business

options.independent_bed_and_breakfast: owner-hosted B&B with 3 to 15 rooms and breakfast included
options.small_inn_or_guesthouse: independent guest house or small inn in the same size band, breakfast optional
options.inn_or_hotel_large: over 15 rooms, or clearly a hotel (inn or boutique hotel ICPs)
options.private_home_room_rental: one or two rooms in a private home, an Airbnb host rather than a business
options.vacation_rental_or_cottages: whole-house or cottage rentals with no hosted rooms
options.directory_or_association: B&B directory, association or booking site listing many properties
options.third_party_managed: run by a management company on behalf of the owner
options.care_home_or_other: retirement home, care home, rehab or anything called a guest house that is not lodging
options.restaurant_only: breakfast restaurant or cafe with no rooms
options.closed_or_for_sale: closed, listed for sale as a turnkey business, or no longer accepting guests
